invariant_patterns.brief: A UNIQUE constraint on (sku, location) rejects a second row for the same pair at the DB, so two stored duplicates can never exist (R3).
sku is NOT NULL: inserting a row with a null sku is rejected by the DB.
CHECK (quantity >= 0) rejects a negative quantity at the DB, so a stored negative stock level is impossible (R2).
Filing is a single INSERT ... ON CONFLICT (sku, location) DO UPDATE in one transaction: a re-file updates the one existing row in place, and a rejected write leaves the table unchanged.

Initial create_table: after downgrade to the migration's down_revision then upgrade head, stock_records and its columns, unique and check constraints are present again (schema recreated; no data-survival claim for the initial creation).
